about: Calques and misused phrases found in English written by speakers of Russian, each with the form to use instead. `find` is a case-insensitive regular expression, narrowed to the contexts in which the phrase is an error. A match is a prompt to reread the phrase, not proof of an error.

calques.use: is in, is kept in, is set out in
calques.why: In English, "stand in" means "replace" and "stand on" means "insist on", as in "stand on ceremony"; neither means "be located in".
"stands as" is a calque of «стоит как».
Said of a rule or a node, "carry out" is a calque of «выполнять»; a rule is implemented, a task is carried out.

calques.use: contains, is stored in; or "is true", "applies"
calques.why: "hold" means both "contain" and "be true"; in a text where both senses occur, a reader cannot tell which is meant.

calques.use: is responsible for, is accountable for
calques.why: "answer for" is a calque of «отвечать за»; in English it suggests being punished for wrongdoing.

calques.use: on a commit, on a push, after each edit
calques.why: "at a commit" is a calque of «при коммите».

calques.use: the single source, the only judgement
calques.why: "the one" also reads as "the right one"; "single source of truth" is the fixed phrase.

calques.use: So a rule says not X but Y
calques.why: A sentence with no verb, "So not X, but Y", is a calque of «Так, не X, а Y».
An absolute construction such as "those of the archive included" is a calque; English puts "including" or "except" first.
"is made of" is said of a material; a document or a system consists of its parts.
"rightly" means «справедливо, с полным правом», not «правильно».
"apart" after a verb is a calque of «порознь».
"Written so" is archaic.
"alike" after a verb is a calque of «одинаково».
"at present" is a calque of «на настоящий момент» and reads as formal.
"has the status X" is a calque of «имеет статус X».
"a sort of" also means "something like", so a reader cannot tell whether a kind or a vague likeness is meant.
"at once" means both «сразу» and «все одновременно», so a reader cannot tell which is meant.
"three words running" is a calque of «три слова подряд».
"is said in the words" is a calque of «говорится словами».
"one step later" is a calque of «на шаг позже».
"contracts" used as the name of a section and followed by a singular verb reads as the plural noun with a verb that does not agree with it.

calques.use: carry … into the code, freeze … in the code
calques.why: "fix" reads as «исправить», not «зафиксировать».
